test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 02 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: River Ganga joins which of the following water bodies?
solution:
The correct option is __**Bay of Bengal.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**Bay of Bengal:**

 
• It occupies an **area** of about **839,000 square miles, or 2,173,000 square kilometers.**
 
• Its borders are to the** north by Bangladesh**, to the **west by Sri Lanka and India**, and to the **east by Myanmar (Burma)**
